rawIntent: Angular ,Asp.Net core Webapi with CQRS pattern,SQL Lite databse

layers: PharmAPI.Api (Presentation / Web API Controllers / Swagger OpenAPI)
PharmAPI.Application (CQRS Commands, Queries, Handlers, Behaviors, DTOs, Interfaces)
PharmAPI.Domain (Entities, Value Objects, Domain Exceptions, Enums)
PharmAPI.Infrastructure (Persistence, EF Core DbContext, SQLite Repositories, External Services)

implementationPolicy.apiDesign: RESTful HTTP JSON endpoints with proper status codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 500) and Swagger annotations
implementationPolicy.cqrs: Strict segregation of Commands (mutating state, returning Result/Unit) and Queries (read-only, non-tracking) via MediatR
implementationPolicy.solid: Single Responsibility handlers, Open/Closed domain models, Liskov Substitution abstractions, Interface Segregation contracts, Dependency Inversion IoC
implementationPolicy.cleanCode: Explicit dependency injection, async/await I/O, domain rule encapsulation, structured error handling

unobservedFacts.authProvider: UNKNOWN (Legacy uses FormsAuth/Session; JWT bearer authentication to be clarified)
